Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
HOT PLATE, WAX LEVELLING, DENTAL 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Specifies tiie requirements for wax levelling hot plate used in dentistry. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

2.1 The tolerances on various dimensions, where not specified, shall be permitted as given below: 

a) ± 0'2 mm on dimensions up to 5*0 mm; 

b) ± 0*5 mm on dimensions above 5'0 mm and up to 10"0 mm; 

c) ± VO mm on dimensions above lO'O mm and up to 50'0 mm; 

d) ± 2'0 mm on dimensions above 500 mm and up to 100*0 mm; and 

e) dz 5'0 mm on dimensions above 100*0 mm. 

3. Materials 

ZA Blade, Ferrule and F//7 — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 02Cr17Ni12Mo2 of 
)S : 6^^ 1 -1 972 'Specification for stairiJess stee) pJate, sheet ar>6 strip', 

3.2 Haridle — \Nood conforming to 15:620-1975 'General requirements for wooden tool handles 
( third revision)', 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The surfaces of the blade of levelling plate shall be finished smooth on both sides and the edge 
shall be bevelled as shown in Fig. 1. The blade shall be flexible enough so that it does not acquire a 
permanent set when bent during use. 

4.2 The handle shall conform to Class 5 handle of IS ; 620-1975; 

4.3 The handle shall be finished smooth and given a thin coat of varnish.

4.4 The handle shall be fixed to the tang of the blade securely and firmly so that it does not become 
loose during use. 

5. Marking — The levelling plate shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, 
initials or trade-mark, and the country of manufacture. 

5.1 /S/ Certification Marl<ing — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

6. Packing — The levelling plate shall be put in a polyethylene bag carrying the name of the item, 
manufacturer's name and trade-mark and the country of manufacture. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1966. The revised version of the standard incorporates 
tolerances on various dimensions. The thickness of hot plate has also been increased to raise its heat 
retaining capacity. The shape of the handle is modified in the revised standard.
